integrity: Includes exact explicit witness, self-contained infinite proof, and standalone exact finite verifier; no external program or downloaded paper is needed to reproduce finite checks.
scientific_limitations: Sharp threshold only for characteristic three; the weaker He Conjecture 22 remains open here. Gao--Geroldinger 2003 already implies related higher-rank examples by combination with a quotient argument. The rank-three example and positive ranks one/two are the specific distinguishing claim. Equivalent unlocated literature remains possible; no independent audit.
title: A sharp rank-three obstruction to cyclic-line separation for zero-sum-free sequences
